name: Exp_KWAN_CCC
summary: This EA is based on the KWAN CCC (Cumulative Cumulative Count) indicator, a momentum-based oscillator that cumulates price changes to identify trend strength and divergence. It generates trade signals when the CCC oscillator crosses its signal line or reaches extreme levels, opening positions in the direction of the prevailing momentum.
summary_zh: 该EA基于KWAN CCC（累积累积计数）指标，这是一种动量振荡器，通过累积价格变化来识别趋势强度和背离。当CCC振荡器穿越其信号线或达到极端水平时，EA沿动量方向开仓交易。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于KWAN CCC指标，该指标是一种累积动量振荡器，通过累计价格变化来衡量市场动量的方向和强度。入场条件为CCC指标线穿越其信号线时开仓——上穿做多，下穿做空；部分版本还包含超买超卖区域的极端值反转入场逻辑。出场条件通常包括固定的止盈止损，以及当CCC指标出现反向穿越信号时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数方式，未发现复杂的资金管理模块。资金管理方面缺乏动态调整机制，如根据ATR或波动率自适应调整仓位大小，整体风控依赖固定止损参数。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is built around the KWAN CCC indicator, a cumulative momentum oscillator that accumulates price changes to gauge the direction and strength of market momentum. Entry conditions trigger when the CCC line crosses its signal line — an upward crossover opens a long position, while a downward crossover opens a short position; some variants also include extreme-level reversal entries when the oscillator reaches overbought or oversold zones. Exit conditions typically consist of fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, as well as closing positions when a reverse crossover signal appears on the CCC indicator. Position sizing generally uses fixed lot sizes or a simple percentage-of-balance approach, with no sophisticated adaptive sizing module detected. Money management lacks dynamic adjustment mechanisms such as ATR-based or volatility-adaptive position sizing, and overall risk control relies on fixed stop-loss parameter values.

pros: 基于累积动量指标，能有效捕捉趋势的中期方向变化
信号线交叉机制提供客观的入场和出场规则，减少主观判断
参数结构简洁，用户易于理解和调优
支持多时间周期应用，灵活性较好
pros_en: Based on a cumulative momentum indicator, it effectively captures mid-term directional changes in trends
The signal line crossover mechanism provides objective entry and exit rules, reducing subjective judgment
Clean parameter structure makes it easy for users to understand and optimize
Supports multi-timeframe application, offering good flexibility
cons: 固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动期可能频繁止损
缺乏持仓检查和新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
未包含点差过滤，在低流动性时段可能因宽点差而入场不利
无动态仓位管理，无法根据账户风险自动调整手数
动量振荡器在震荡市中容易产生虚假信号导致频繁亏损
cons_en: Fixed stop-loss and take-profit do not account for market volatility changes, which may cause frequent stop-outs during high-volatility periods
Lacks position check and new bar check mechanisms, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
No spread filter included, which may lead to unfavorable entries during low-liquidity sessions with wide spreads
No dynamic position sizing, unable to automatically adjust lot size based on account risk
Momentum oscillators tend to generate false signals in ranging markets, leading to frequent losses
improvements: 增加ATR自适应止损止盈，根据市场波动率动态调整风控参数
添加新K线检查和持仓检查逻辑，防止重复开仓
引入点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免低流动性时段的不利入场
improvements_en: Add ATR-adaptive stop-loss and take-profit to dynamically adjust risk parameters based on market volatility
Implement new bar check and position check logic to prevent duplicate entries on the same bar
Introduce spread filter and trading session filter to avoid unfavorable entries during low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一K线多次重复开仓
固定止损未根据波动率调整，高波动行情下风险敞口不可控
震荡行情中动量指标虚假信号频繁，可能造成连续亏损
risk_points_en: Lack of new bar check may cause multiple duplicate entries on the same bar
Fixed stop-loss not adjusted for volatility means uncontrolled risk exposure during high-volatility conditions
Momentum indicator generates frequent false signals in ranging markets, potentially causing consecutive losses

It generates trade signals when the CCC oscillator crosses its signal line or reaches extreme levels, opening positions in the direction of the prevailing momentum.
